changes: Implemented the proof admissibility registry MVP: added canonical scope/role/claim/consumer/producer/reason-code types, a fail-closed evaluator, proof surface inventory docs/JSON, and a proof-admissibility smoke test script.
usage: Use npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility to verify the registry and evaluator. Import evaluateProofAdmissibility from packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts for future gate integrations.
expectedOutcome: Non-production proof-looking artifacts are classified as non-production and cannot support productionDone; only a bound authority-receipt-ref production gate decision can be production eligible when every required check passes.
actualTranscript: npm --prefix packages/main run build passed; npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility printed proof-admissibility smoke passed; lattice validate --story=B-0985 --json passed 30/30 configured commands with 12/12 verification intents covered; quorum_submit recorded 3 rounds x 2 hosts.
outcomeDiff: No difference for this M0/M1 MVP slice: expected registry, docs, fail-closed evaluator, smoke test, validation, delivery check, and 3x2 local quorum all passed.
limitations: This slice is warn/classification foundation only. It does not yet enforce all production gates, migrate handoff evidence, change Authority Server production receipt behavior, or add reserved-key sanitizer enforcement.
pitfalls: F-001 through F-006 exposed important fail-open and naming risks: omitted checks, null/non-true check values, missing contractVersion, and inconsistent local-gate-evidence wording. Future work should keep required checks exact-true and keep raw authority-receipt distinct from authority-receipt-ref.
